answer: Resist Sybil with refundable stake: each agent locks a bond (saffron units) slashed if two IDs share grading patterns or keys. Fakes must post N bonds and act independently, costing real capital and compute per clone. A velvet attestation gate forces new IDs to be vouched by honest agents before grading, raising onboarding cost. A jade-weighted reputation devalues correlated accounts. Attackers pay upfront and forfeit bonds on detection — scaling fakes scales loss.
